# Ideator Labs

> Ideator Labs is a studio at the intersection of AI and data advisory, innovation and business intelligence: we help businesses use AI and data to decide better, and build the tools and products that make it happen.

Sectors we work in today, with the product made for each: retail (FurniTrail), multi-location restaurant, salon and retail chains (Plumbline), salons and spas (Chairside), B2B companies and agencies (PollenRev), accounting and CA firms (Docketbox), D2C brands (Profora), clinics and healthcare practices (CareCadence), finance and lending (Cashtrail), manufacturing (Taktline), and logistics and supply chain (FreightProof); advisory in every sector. More sectors follow as each product is ready.

## Products

- [Products](https://ideatorlabs.github.io/products/): Overview of what Ideator Labs builds and researches.
- [PollenRev](https://ideatorlabs.github.io/products/pollenrev/): PollenRev is sales software for small and mid-sized businesses. It finds leads on Google Maps, OpenStreetMap, Google search, Instagram and LinkedIn, scores them against your ideal customer, writes outreach, proposals and pitch decks in your brand’s voice, and tracks each deal in a sales pipeline. Book a demo through the contact page.
<!-- sector-products:start -->
- [FurniTrail by Ideator Labs](https://ideatorlabs.github.io/products/furnitrail/): FurniTrail is daily workflow software for furniture and mattress showrooms with one to three branches. Every walk-in, quotation, advance, delivery and complaint becomes a tracked item with an owner, a deadline and proof to close it. Anything that slips is escalated to the owner, who sees the whole store on one screen each morning. Book a demo through the contact page.
- [Plumbline by Ideator Labs](https://ideatorlabs.github.io/products/plumbline/): Plumbline is operations software for QSR and café chains of 10 to 100 outlets in India. Audits, stock counts, cash-ups, supply orders, licence renewals, crew training and guest complaints each live in their own module, on one sign-in. Whatever goes wrong at an outlet becomes an item with an owner, a deadline and proof, and anything late goes to the area manager and then head office without anyone chasing it. Book a demo through the contact page.
- [Chairside by Ideator Labs](https://ideatorlabs.github.io/products/chairside/): Chairside works next to your salon POS for owner-run salon, spa and grooming chains with 3 to 15 outlets. Each package use is confirmed by the client on their own phone, clients due back get a ready WhatsApp message from the desk, and commission is worked out only from checked services. Anything left undone has an owner and a deadline, and reaches the outlet manager and then the owner. Book a demo through the contact page.
- [Docketbox by Ideator Labs](https://ideatorlabs.github.io/products/docketbox/): Docketbox gives a CA practice one task for every client, return and period, such as GSTR-3B for October or a TDS statement for Q2, with its statutory due date and the papers it needs. Each task has an owner and moves from waiting on the client to documents received, in progress, partner review, approved and filed, and it closes only with the acknowledgement number and file. Late tasks go to the managers and partners on fixed days, and partners get a digest every morning. Book a demo through the contact page.
- [Profora by Ideator Labs](https://ideatorlabs.github.io/products/profora/): Profora finds where a D2C brand loses money after returns, COD fees, shipping and gateway charges: products, campaigns below break-even and pincode areas where COD orders lose money. Each leak goes to the person who can fix it, with a deadline, proof of the fix and escalation when it slips. It closes only when later settled orders show the fix paid back. Book a demo through the contact page.
- [CareCadence by Ideator Labs](https://ideatorlabs.github.io/products/carecadence/): CareCadence tracks every patient due back, every unpaid balance and every insurer claim as an item with someone responsible, a due date and proof. The doctor sets a follow-up with one tap, the front desk works one list each morning, and an item closes only on a recorded visit, payment or settlement. The owner sees money recovered from those records, and every item that slipped past its date. Book a demo through the contact page.
- [Cashtrail by Ideator Labs](https://ideatorlabs.github.io/products/cashtrail/): Cashtrail runs the statement review for each loan application as a case. It reads the statements, checks every balance, looks for signs a PDF was edited and turns what needs a look into flags. An analyst clears each flag with a note, a second person signs the case off, and the loan system receives it with a PDF report. Book a demo through the contact page.
- [Taktline by Ideator Labs](https://ideatorlabs.github.io/products/taktline/): Taktline is plant operations software for small and mid-sized manufacturers that keep stock in Tally. Machine stops, faults found on checks, items about to run out and late supplier orders each become an action with an owner, a deadline and proof, and late ones go to the supervisor, then the owner. A Stock-only plan serves distributors. Book a demo through the contact page.
- [FreightProof by Ideator Labs](https://ideatorlabs.github.io/products/freightproof/): FreightProof is for manufacturers and distributors that buy road freight from several transporters without a transport management system. Each bill is checked against the LR register and the rate card in force on the LR date, and each overcharge becomes a claim with an owner, a deadline and its evidence. Open claims are held back on the pay list until the transporter issues a credit note or agrees a set-off. Book a demo through the contact page.
<!-- sector-products:end -->

## Advisory

- [Advisory](https://ideatorlabs.github.io/solutions/): Starts with a free 25-minute call, then a fixed-fee diagnostic that finds where a business loses time or margin and what to fix first, then an optional build. Method: VALUE OS (Baseline, Diagnose, Quantify, Design, Drive). If the diagnostic finds nothing worth fixing, we say so plainly. Fees are not published.
- [Sectors](https://ideatorlabs.github.io/industries/): The sectors we work in today and how to suggest the next one.

## Blog

- [Ideator Labs blog](https://ideatorlabs.github.io/blog/): Plain-language articles on AI, data engineering, business intelligence and the sectors we work in. Every fact sourced and dated.
- [How we write](https://ideatorlabs.github.io/blog/how-we-write/): How articles are researched, checked and corrected.
- [Innovation](https://ideatorlabs.github.io/blog/innovation/): Picking, testing and shipping new tools without a big IT project, and knowing when not to.
- [CA and accounting firms](https://ideatorlabs.github.io/blog/ca-firms/): Where accounting practices lose hours to matching, re-typing and chasing, and how to win them back.
- [D2C brands](https://ideatorlabs.github.io/blog/d2c/): The real margin on each order, after returns, shipping, fees and ads.
- [FurniTrail](https://ideatorlabs.github.io/blog/furnitrail/): For furniture showroom owners: turning walk-in visitors into buyers with timely, personal follow-up.
- [Plumbline](https://ideatorlabs.github.io/blog/plumbline/): For QSR and café chain operators: audits, stock variance, cash and supply across every outlet, each issue closed with proof.
- [Chairside](https://ideatorlabs.github.io/blog/chairside/): For salon and spa owners: packages, regular clients coming back on time, and commission everyone trusts.
- [Docketbox](https://ideatorlabs.github.io/blog/docketbox/): For CA firms: every client deadline, paper and approval tracked until the return is filed.
- [Profora](https://ideatorlabs.github.io/blog/profora/): For D2C founders: finding the products, campaigns and pincodes that lose money, and fixing them.
- [CareCadence](https://ideatorlabs.github.io/blog/carecadence/): For private clinics: follow-up visits, unpaid balances and insurer claims that don't slip.
- [Cashtrail](https://ideatorlabs.github.io/blog/cashtrail/): For credit teams at NBFCs and DSAs: reviewing bank statements quickly and catching tampering.
- [Taktline](https://ideatorlabs.github.io/blog/taktline/): For plant owners and managers: machine stops, maintenance and stock tracked to a verified close.
- [FreightProof](https://ideatorlabs.github.io/blog/freightproof/): For logistics and finance teams: checking transporter bills and recovering overcharges.
- [Where CA firms lose hours every week, and how AI gives them back](https://ideatorlabs.github.io/blog/ca-firms-reclaim-hours-with-ai.html): The time goes into data work, not advice. Here is where it hides and how to win it back one task at a time.
- [Your D2C brand’s real problem isn’t ads, it’s true margin per order](https://ideatorlabs.github.io/blog/d2c-true-margin-per-order.html): Before you change the ads, find out what each order really leaves you with.
- [Why furniture showrooms lose walk-in buyers, and how to follow up](https://ideatorlabs.github.io/blog/furnitrail/furniture-showroom-walk-in-follow-up.html): What to capture at the door, what to send, and when.
- [How to tell if a new tool will pay off in your business](https://ideatorlabs.github.io/blog/evaluate-technology-for-your-business.html): A simple way to judge a tool against how things work today.
- [Why clinics lose follow-ups, balances and claims, and how to keep each one moving](https://ideatorlabs.github.io/blog/carecadence/clinic-follow-ups-balances-claims.html): Give every recall, balance and claim an owner, a due date and proof, until a visit, payment or settlement closes it.
- [How credit teams spot edited bank statements before sanction](https://ideatorlabs.github.io/blog/cashtrail/spot-edited-bank-statements-before-sanction.html): The checks that catch an edited statement, and the notes and sign-off that prove you ran them.
- [Why salons lose regular clients and money on packages and commission, and how to stop it](https://ideatorlabs.github.io/blog/chairside/salon-packages-due-back-commission.html): Three leaks in one salon: clients who drift away, package uses nobody can prove, and commission argued at month-end.
- [How CA firms miss GST, TDS and ROC due dates, what it costs, and how to stop](https://ideatorlabs.github.io/blog/docketbox/ca-firm-due-date-tracking-gst-tds-roc.html): What a late GST, TDS or ROC filing costs, and how firms keep every return on time.
- [How to audit freight bills before you pay a transporter](https://ideatorlabs.github.io/blog/freightproof/freight-bill-audit-before-payment.html): Five places bills go wrong, how to check each one, and how to get overpayments back.
- [Where QSR chains lose money between outlets](https://ideatorlabs.github.io/blog/plumbline/qsr-chain-money-leaks-between-outlets.html): Four leaks that show up outlet by outlet, and a weekly routine to catch each one.
- [Find the SKUs, ads and COD pincodes that lose money](https://ideatorlabs.github.io/blog/profora/find-loss-making-skus-campaigns-cod-pincodes.html): Where a D2C brand loses money after returns, RTO, shipping and fees, and what to do about each.
- [Cut machine downtime and late deliveries](https://ideatorlabs.github.io/blog/taktline/measure-machine-downtime-late-deliveries.html): What to log on the floor, what to review each week and what it costs, for plants that keep their books in Tally.

## Company

- [About](https://ideatorlabs.github.io/about/): Who Ideator Labs is and how it works.
- [Research](https://ideatorlabs.github.io/research/): What we are researching: CORTEX and YAMCP (open source) and Brain (experiments toward an open-source, brain-inspired AI companion, drawing on existing neuroscience and AI research; research, not a product).
- [Open source](https://ideatorlabs.github.io/open-source/): CORTEX, a public repository that includes YAMCP, a Model Context Protocol server framework; and five Python packages: Greenline (WhatsApp Cloud API engine), TillSync (POS and spreadsheet connectors), Nudgewright (personal customer message lines with reasons), Faultbell (exception alerts and server watch, to chat, paging and email) and Leadbell (website lead capture with consent, plus sign-up, lead and payment alerts).
